string-array.name: whats_new_bodies
string-array.item: Censor now opens videos as well as photos. Draw a rectangle over anything private, set when it starts and ends on the timeline, and save a copy with it pixelated, blurred or blacked out, and no metadata.
Select an area in a video and turn on Moves, then move it at another moment. Redact slides it smoothly between the places you set, so a face or a number plate stays covered as it moves.

Tell Redact what the photos are for, like sending them to people you know or keeping them for yourself, and it sets the options for you. Find Preset at the top of Settings › Metadata Cleaning, or tap the first chip on the Clean tab.
Settings › About › Tell a Friend About Redact opens your share sheet with a short message and the Google Play link. You can edit it before sending, and no photo or file is ever attached.
After an update, this screen explains what changed, once. You can open it again any time from Settings › About › What\'s New.
Drag the handle on the left of the Censor toolbar to put it anywhere over the photo or video. Double-tap the handle to send it back to the bottom.
